phases.name: Core Engine
phases.description: Build the foundational clipboard monitoring service, local storage layer, and deduplication logic. This phase produces a headless daemon that captures clipboard events and persists them to SQLite.
tasks: Initialize Tauri 2 project with Rust backend and WebView frontend scaffolding
Implement macOS clipboard polling via NSPasteboard API in Rust
Define SQLite schema for clipboard entries (id, content_type, payload, source_app, timestamp, hash, pinned, tags)
Build clipboard entry storage and retrieval layer with SQLite
Implement content hashing for deduplication of consecutive identical copies
Support text, image (PNG/TIFF), and file reference content types
Add configurable history size limit with automatic pruning of oldest unpinned entries
Store source application metadata (bundle ID, app name) for each clipboard event
Write unit tests for storage, deduplication, and pruning logic
Benchmark clipboard capture latency target: under 50ms

phases.name: User Interface
phases.description: Build the clipboard history panel, search interface, item preview, and pin/favorites management. The panel appears as a floating window triggered by global hotkey.
tasks: Design panel layout: history list, search bar, preview pane, pinned section
Implement scrollable clipboard history list with item type indicators
Build full-text search with real-time filtering as the user types
Add content type filter controls (text, image, file)
Add source application filter
Implement item preview for text (with syntax highlighting for code), images (thumbnail), and files (icon and path)
Build pin/unpin toggle on each clipboard entry
Create pinned favorites section at top of panel with drag-to-reorder
Display timestamp and source app metadata per entry
Implement paste action: selecting an item writes it to clipboard and closes panel
Style the panel to match macOS system appearance (light and dark mode)

phases.name: System Integration
phases.description: Wire up macOS system-level features: global hotkey registration, accessibility permission requests, login item registration, and menu bar presence.
tasks: Register global keyboard shortcut for panel activation (default: Cmd+Shift+V)
Implement accessibility permission check and prompt on first launch
Add launch-at-login toggle using SMAppService or LaunchAgents
Create menu bar icon with dropdown for quick access, preferences, and quit
Handle permission denial gracefully with user-facing guidance
Ensure clipboard monitoring resumes correctly after sleep/wake cycles
Handle multiple displays and position panel on the active screen
Test compatibility with macOS 12 through macOS 15

phases.name: Polish and Advanced Features
phases.description: Add categories, tags, keyboard navigation refinements, animations, and the optional iCloud sync feature. Harden edge cases and improve perceived performance.
tasks: Implement color-coded tags with create, assign, and remove operations
Build custom categories for organizing clipboard entries
Add tag and category filter to the search panel
Refine keyboard navigation: arrow keys to browse, Return to paste, Escape to close, number keys 1-9 for quick select
Add subtle open/close animations for the panel (configurable, can be disabled)
Implement sensitive content detection to auto-exclude password manager entries
Build clear-all-history action with confirmation
Add preferences window: hotkey customization, history size, launch at login, sync toggle
Implement optional iCloud sync via NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore or CloudKit
Make sync scope configurable: all items, pinned only, or tagged only
Add free tier enforcement: 50-item cap with upgrade prompt
Implement Pro license validation via Gumroad license key

phases.name: Packaging and Signing
phases.description: Produce a distributable universal binary DMG, signed and notarized for macOS Gatekeeper compliance.
tasks: Configure Tauri build for universal binary (aarch64 + x86_64)
Set up Apple Developer signing with Developer ID certificate
Configure entitlements for clipboard access and accessibility
Build DMG installer with application icon, background image, and Applications symlink
Submit build to Apple notarization service and staple the ticket
Verify Gatekeeper acceptance on a clean macOS install
Generate SHA-256 checksums for all distributed binaries
Automate the build and signing pipeline via shell script or CI
Validate binary size target: under 15 MB

phases.name: Release and Distribution
phases.description: Publish the initial release on GitHub and Gumroad. Prepare documentation, screenshots, and promotional materials.
tasks: Create GitHub repository under RISE Studio Labs organization
Write README with product description, installation instructions, and feature overview
Capture application screenshots for documentation and storefront
Record a short demo GIF showing clipboard capture, search, and paste workflow
Draft release notes for v0.1.0
Publish GitHub Release with DMG, checksums, and release notes
Set up Gumroad product page with description, screenshots, and pricing tiers
Configure Gumroad license key generation for Pro tier
Create a minimal landing page or link from existing RISE Studio Labs site
Announce release in relevant developer and macOS communities

notes: Phase order is sequential but some tasks across phases can overlap.
Core Engine and UI phases carry the highest risk and should be prioritized.
System Integration depends on Core Engine completion.
Polish phase items are individually deferrable if timeline requires it.
iCloud sync is the most complex single feature and can ship in a point release if needed.
